news.headline: The drugmaker Abivax has still not been acquired. What's going on?
news.summary: STAT examines why Abivax, widely tipped since January 2026 as one of biotech's most likely M&A targets amid Eli Lilly takeover chatter, remains independent nine months into the year despite a red-hot biotech M&A market and modeled deal values as high as $20-23 billion. The piece signals that acquisition speculation has cooled for now even as the company pushes ahead alone toward a U.S. launch.

news.headline: 3 Takeover Targets in Immunology: Abivax, Spyre, MoonLake
news.summary: PharmaVoice names Abivax alongside Spyre Therapeutics and MoonLake Immunotherapeutics as leading potential acquisition targets in a thriving autoimmune/immunology dealmaking environment, recapping the January 2026 Eli Lilly takeover rumors that CEO Marc de Garidel dismissed as 'noise.' The article underscores that Big Pharma M&A interest in Abivax's obefazimod remains a live investor narrative even without a confirmed deal.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Positive Pre-NDA Interaction with the FDA for Obefazimod
news.summary: Abivax said the FDA gave constructive feedback aligning with the company's planned New Drug Application content and format for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis, de-risking the regulatory pathway. The company remains on track to submit its first NDA by the end of 2026.

news.headline: Morgan Stanley raises Abivax price target to $180 from $132, keeps Overweight
news.summary: Morgan Stanley substantially raised its price target citing confidence following the ABTECT Part 2 maintenance safety update and the company's strengthened balance sheet after its large capital raise. The move added to a wave of bullish sell-side reaction to Abivax's de-risked safety profile.

news.headline: Abivax Strengthens Commercial Capabilities With Strategic Leadership Appointments
news.summary: Abivax named four new commercial leaders spanning marketing, patient services, sales and market access, including a Global Head of Marketing with prior Amgen (TEZSPIRE) and Takeda (ENTYVIO) launch experience. The hires signal concrete build-out of a U.S. commercial organization ahead of the planned Q4 2026 NDA filing and potential solo launch.

news.headline: Abivax Announces Closing of $920 Million Public Offering
news.summary: Abivax closed an upsized underwritten offering of 7.36 million ADSs (with underwriters' option fully exercised) for gross proceeds of about $920 million (~EUR 807 million), among the largest biotech follow-on raises of the year. Management said the proceeds, combined with existing cash, extend the runway into Q2 2029 and are earmarked mainly for a potential independent U.S. commercialization of obefazimod.

catalysts.label: H1 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Abivax is scheduled to report first-half 2026 financial results, which should update cash runway (post the $920M raise), R&D/SG&A spend trends, and give a progress update on NDA preparation and commercial build-out.

catalysts.label: FDA NDA submission for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis
catalysts.detail: Following a positive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA in July 2026, Abivax plans to submit its first New Drug Application for obefazimod in moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis by the end of 2026. This is the single biggest near-term regulatory catalyst and a prerequisite for a potential 2027 U.S. launch.

catalysts.label: EMA Marketing Authorization Application (MAA) filing
catalysts.detail: Abivax is pursuing dual regulatory filings and plans to submit a Marketing Authorization Application to the European Medicines Agency for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis in the second half of 2026, pending final maintenance data packaging.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results / corporate update
catalysts.detail: Abivax's next scheduled quarterly financial update, which should provide the most current view on NDA submission timing, cash position, and U.S. launch-readiness progress.

catalysts.label: ENHANCE-CD Phase 2b induction data (Crohn's disease)
catalysts.detail: Topline 12-week induction results from the Phase 2b ENHANCE-CD trial of obefazimod in moderate-to-severely active Crohn's disease were earlier guided for late 2026, though Abivax's own pipeline page has more recently pointed to a mid-2027 readout - timing should be confirmed at the H1 2026 results call.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA approval / PDUFA decision on obefazimod (UC)
catalysts.detail: Assuming an on-time NDA submission in Q4 2026 and standard FDA review timelines, a first approval decision for obefazimod in ulcerative colitis would be expected roughly in the first half of 2027 - this would be the key value-inflection event for the underlying stock.

catalysts.label: Targeted U.S. commercial launch of obefazimod
catalysts.detail: Management has previously indicated it is targeting a U.S. launch of obefazimod in ulcerative colitis around Q3 2027, contingent on FDA approval; the newly built commercial organization and the $920M raise are explicitly intended to support a potential solo (non-partnered) launch.

catalysts.label: Potential EMA approval and European launch
catalysts.detail: Following the planned H2 2026 EMA filing, a European marketing authorization decision and subsequent launch preparations would be expected to follow in 2027, on a broadly similar timeline to the U.S. process.

catalysts.label: M&A / takeover speculation
catalysts.detail: Abivax has repeatedly been named a top biotech takeover candidate (Eli Lilly rumors in January 2026, broader Big Pharma speculation citing immunology/inflammation strategic fit, valuations discussed up to ~$20-23 billion, and an August 2026 PharmaVoice piece grouping it with Spyre and MoonLake as leading autoimmune M&A targets). As of early September 2026 no deal has materialized and management has emphasized building an independent U.S. commercial capability instead, but renewed bid speculation remains a standing binary catalyst for the shares.

catalysts.label: Additional obefazimod safety database maturation
catalysts.detail: Abivax continues to expand its long-term safety dataset (including ABTECT Maintenance Part 2 and open-label extension data) to address prior investor concerns about malignancy signals seen in earlier data cuts; further updates could move the stock ahead of the NDA filing.

pulse: ABVX (NASDAQ ADR) has pulled back from its summer highs near $145 to trade around $122-$130 in early September 2026, holding most of its huge 2026 gains after June's Phase 3 ABTECT maintenance data and the subsequent $920 million capital raise, with sell-side analysts broadly Strong Buy and price targets clustering around $150-$180 (Morgan Stanley at $180, consensus near $150-$155). News flow has been quieter since late July - obefazimod's Phase 3 ulcerative colitis program remains de-risked following a constructive pre-NDA meeting with the FDA (July 30) and a build-out of U.S. commercial leadership, keeping the company on track for a planned Q4 2026 FDA NDA filing (and an H2 2026 EMA filing) ahead of a targeted 2027 launch. The dominant investor debate is still whether a Big Pharma buyer emerges: persistent takeover speculation (Eli Lilly rumors, ~$20-23B valuations floated, and Abivax's continued inclusion in press round-ups of top immunology M&A targets) has not produced a deal as of early September, prompting STAT to ask why not, so near-term watch items are the September 21 H1 2026 results (cash runway, NDA prep detail), any fresh M&A chatter, and progress toward the year-end NDA submission.
